reason: the correctness lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: correctness lens, high: `_cycle_dispatch` emits `stage.start` for every cycle member dispatch where `_cd_iter > 0` without a `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard, so on every fresh cycle-based run each cycle member now emits a `stage.start` event — a change to the event contract the design explicitly prohibited for non-resume paths. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3204; fix: code)

correctness lens, medium: The FRSH-2 fresh-run sub-case only asserts that `intake` emits exactly one `stage.start`; it never asserts that cycle members do NOT emit `stage.start` on a fresh run, so the spurious `stage.start` emission introduced by finding 1 passes the guard undetected. (tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh:718; fix: test)

correctness lens, medium: When both `resume_mode=true` and `from_stage` is set, `_artifact_persist_restore` is called twice: first inside `_runner_resume_rehydrate` at line ~2897, then again here inside `_runner_from_stage_preflight`. Both failures are silently swallowed (`|| true`), so a git-state-branch read failure leaves the preflight to report "has no restorable primary artifact" with no prior indication of why restoration actually failed. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1735; fix: code)
